messages:
alexa (devex): FYI: ran into a confusing onboarding case — sample-app in docker-compose had REDWOOD_PROJECT set, but engineers passing `--project -` from makefile to intentionally clear project. SDK treated `-` as a literal project name which caused failed perms. wanted to flag for parity and recommended UX.
jorge (cli): we historically treat `-` as a path shorthand in other CLIs. maybe clobbering it here is poor.
tom (sdk): interesting — across languages we only check for non-empty string. sentinel values like `-` or `NONE` will be accepted. that's fragile.
mei (security): risk: people intentionally pass a sentinel to avoid project-scoped keys, expecting global/org behavior. if SDK interprets it as a valid project, it exposes unexpected access errors and noisy 403s. also rotation scripts that zero-out REDWOOD_PROJECT may inadvertently set sentinel.
rachel (docs): ops doc needs a clear table: accepted "clear" verbs (omit, empty, `-`, `NONE`) and what they mean. but I'd prefer a single consistent rule rather than many special cases.
ci-bot: CI lint: sample-app tests failing in js/python auth-integration (project mismatch).
alexa (devex): proposal from devex: canonicalize rules so SDKs/CLI understand three states for scope: explicit(projectName), unset(use env/config), cleared(intentionally clear to org-wide). propose sentinel `--project ''` (empty) == unset, `--project null` (literal string equals cleared) is confusing. better to add explicit `--no-project` flag to clear.
tom (sdk): I like explicit flags. we can implement: `--project <name>` sets; `--no-project` clears to org scope; if neither, fallback env->config->metadata. SDKs expose provider `resolveScope({flagName, flagNoProject, env, config, default})`.
mei (security): security + rotation note: when rotating keys you might swap from a project-scoped key to a newly created org key. we need a recommended step-by-step so short-lived automation doesn't break. Suggestion: 1) create new org key, 2) update app to accept both old and new (support dual keys) for a short window, 3) rotate away old key. Also audit log events for key usage.
rachel (docs): I'll draft a rotation recipe with CLI and env examples and include the `--no-project` usage plus recommended TTL for dual-key windows. will also add a warning section about env inheritance into child processes (docker-compose, systemd) so people don't accidentally leak project scope.
jorge (cli): implementation detail: change flag parsing to normalize: empty string -> undefined; `--no-project` flips a boolean; if both `--project` and `--no-project` present, error. update bash completion docs.
tom (sdk): will implement provider in the SDKs and also add telemetry events: scope_resolution = {source: 'flag'|'no-project'|'env'|'config'|'metadata', value_present: boolean}. record when sentinel flags used.
mei (security): add a policy where admin-level ops (key creation/deletion) require explicit project or explicit `--no-project` and won't proceed if scope ambiguous. also add audit log entry for rotation operations.
alexa (devex): tests: unit tests for resolve provider across js/py/go, e2e for docker-compose sample-app, and a small GH Actions job to validate rotation recipe via smoke tests.
ci-bot: opened ticket DEVEX-1498 to track SDK + CLI changes.
rachel (docs): timeline: I'll PR docs with examples and rotation guide tomorrow. tom/jorge please drop PR links when you have SDK/CLI patches.
tom (sdk): will open JS + Python PRs today, tagging @mei for security review. includes migration notes and telemetry.
jorge (cli): I'll add `--no-project` flag and update completions. aiming for next canary.
alexa (devex): perfect. consensus: add explicit `--no-project` to clear scope, treat empty/missing as fallback to env/config, forbid conflicting flags, update SDK provider API and docs, and add rotation recipe + telemetry. thanks everyone :rocket:
